images.title: 늘어난 니트를 들어 보며 웃음이 터진 20대 여성 (대표사진)
images.prompt: Camera and composition: close-up, eye level, one person's face and shoulders fill most of the frame, face placed slightly below the center so the top fifth of the image is softly blurred background (a title band goes there). The person looks thoughtful or curious (finger on chin, looking at a paper or the key object), not scared, sad or in pain. The related scene stays softly blurred in the background. A Korean woman in her 20s with a short bob haircut, wearing a green T-shirt, holding up a cream knit sweater with stretched shoulders toward the camera; a blurred small studio apartment closet behind her. Facial expression: bright happy smile. Color theme: dusty rose and white tones with a green accent. Soft matte clay 3D render, rounded chunky shapes, handmade plasticine texture, gentle studio lighting, miniature diorama feel, richer and more saturated colors than pastel, clear contrast, cozy and warm mood. Base colors cream, apricot, mint, sky blue and warm brown, a little deeper than pastel. Add one bright accent color (coral-red, mustard yellow or cobalt blue) on the main person's clothing or the key object. Korean everyday settings. Show only what is described above as the main subject; do not add other large objects that are not described. Everyone shown looks calm and relaxed; nobody is in pain or scared. Do not draw any written words, letters or numbers anywhere in the image; signs, labels, screens and papers stay blank or use simple icons only. No money, banknotes, coins or currency symbols anywhere.
images.shot: close-up, eye level, face and shoulders
images.bg: dusty rose and white tones with a green accent
